options.text: The kind of media the model makes, such as text or video.
options.explanation: Right. Inputs are what it reads; outputs are what it makes. Check the output side first.

options.text: The file size of its answers.
options.explanation: Size is a limit. Modality is the kind of media.

options.text: The screen or app window where you see the model's finished result.
options.explanation: The screen is only where you view the result. Modality is the kind of media the model makes.

questions.prompt: Can Claude make an image for your campaign?

options.text: Yes, if you ask in a detailed prompt and name the style.
options.explanation: Anthropic's vision docs say Claude cannot generate or edit images. A better prompt does not change that.

options.text: No. Claude reads images and answers in text only.
options.explanation: Right. Use Claude to review an image, and an image model to make one.

questions.prompt: Your client likes an image but wants the sky changed. What does OpenAI's image API offer for this?

options.text: Only a new generation from scratch.
options.explanation: OpenAI's docs list an Edits endpoint that changes an existing image, in part or entirely.

options.text: An edit of the existing image with a new prompt.
options.explanation: Right. Edits modify an existing image, so you keep the parts the client liked.

options.text: A video model, because the sky moves in real life.
options.explanation: The client wants a still image. An image edit fits.
